description: App Sec Village focuses on application security, secure coding practices, API vulnerabilities, and web exploitation. Talks cover dependency security, browser sandbox escapes, threat modeling, Agile security, and developer-oriented security workflows.

talks.title: 10,000 Dependencies Under the Sea
talks.teaser: Explores risks, security challenges, and visibility issues in deeply nested open-source software dependencies.

talks.title: Running an AppSec Program with Open Source
talks.teaser: Shares strategies for building and scaling an effective enterprise application security program using open-source tools.

talks.title: Can't Touch This: Detecting Lateral Movement
talks.teaser: Discusses techniques and telemetry strategies for detecting attacker lateral movement across applications and environments.

talks.title: Secure Your Code: Injections and Logging
talks.teaser: Examines injection vulnerabilities, secure coding practices, and defensive logging strategies for modern applications.

talks.title: Android Bug Foraging
talks.teaser: Demonstrates techniques and workflows for foraging vulnerabilities and hunting bugs across Android applications.

talks.title: Turning Offsec Mindset to Developer's Toolset
talks.teaser: Translates offensive security techniques into practical tools and workflows that developers can use to secure software.

talks.title: localghost: Escaping the Browser Sandbox
talks.teaser: Explores browser sandbox architecture and demonstrates localghost techniques for escaping client-side sandboxes.

talks.title: A Heaven for Hackers: Breaking a Web Security
talks.teaser: Analyzes flaws in web security controls and demonstrates exploitation methods that bypass common defensive boundaries.

talks.title: Threat Modelling the Death Star
talks.teaser: Uses an iconic sci-fi battle station case study to teach structured threat modeling and architectural risk analysis.

talks.title: Who's Secure Who's Not: Who Makes That Choice
talks.teaser: Examines the systemic factors, industry incentives, and decisions that dictate which software and platforms receive security.

talks.title: 2FA in 2020 and Beyond
talks.teaser: Evaluates modern two-factor authentication protocols, phishing resistance, and future directions for identity verification.

talks.title: Hackium: A Browser for Web Hackers
talks.teaser: Introduces Hackium, a Chromium-based browser customized for automating web security analysis and application testing.

talks.title: What Bruce Lee Can Teach Us About AppSec
talks.teaser: Applies martial arts philosophy and adaptability concepts to modern application security operations and team culture.

talks.title: The DevOps and Agile Security Toolkit
talks.teaser: Surveys essential tools and automated practices for embedding security verification into DevOps and Agile pipelines.

talks.title: API inSecurity TOP 10
talks.teaser: Breaks down the OWASP API Security Top 10 vulnerabilities with real-world examples and remediation advice.

talks.title: Threagile: Agile Threat Modeling
talks.teaser: Introduces Threagile, an open-source tool for executing code-driven and agile threat modeling in DevOps workflows.

talks.title: The Elephant in the Room: Burnout
talks.teaser: Addresses systemic burnout in the cybersecurity industry and shares strategies for fostering healthier workplace cultures.
